_help: Which of Shalone's drawings goes in which PICO-8 sprite slot. Each frame takes the next slot (2 frames fill N and N+1; a 16x16 drawing is 2 slots wide and 2 tall). Swap a name when she draws the real one, then: npm run pico8. Slots not listed are left alone, so things drawn in PICO-8's own editor stay.
_slots: 0 priest idle, 2 bishop idle, 4 deacon idle, 6 priest walk, 8 priest blessing (4 frames), 12 bishop walk, 14 deacon walk, 16-27 people walking (6 bases), 32 grace, 33 gift box, 34 rosary, 35 holy water bucket, 36 coffee, 37 car, 41-43 bushes, 44 lilies (spring), 45 pumpkin (fall), 56 bishop blessing (4 frames), 84 angel (4 frames), 72-83 people standing (6 bases, same order as walking)
_big: Her 32x32 art, too big for the sprite sheet: stored in the code and unpacked at start into two extra sprite sheets (upper memory). Order is fixed: add new ones at the end.
_parts: Per group, which of her colors the game swaps for each one. people: every person gets random hair, skin (with matching eyes) and clothes. priest: the bishop's priests get their own skin and eyes. deacon: new deacons get their own skin and eyes; 'vestment' follows the season (spring white, summer green, fall green, winter purple).
_tops: People slots whose top row (the top of the head) is hair or a hat: each person gets one at random.
_colors: Force one of her colors onto a PICO-8 color number (0-15) when the nearest match is wrong or two colors land on the same one.
